items.computation: Invoice date (document_date) is Fri 19.03.2027. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so the 10-day period starts on 20.03.2027. Counting 10 days forward (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Mon 29.03.2027. However 29.03.2027 is Ostermontag (Easter Monday), a public holiday observed nationwide including NW. Under § 193 BGB, when the last day of a period for a declaration or payment falls on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday, it shifts to the next business day: Tue 30.03.2027.
